evals.prompt: Set up this repo for t3code.
evals.expected_output: Runs gh auth status; if multiple logins, asks the user which account this repo uses; pins it with git config t3code.ghAccount; installs .t3code/ensure-gh-identity.sh; creates/merges t3.json with a runOnWorktreeCreate identity script; runs the guard and reports state; reminds to commit t3.json and .t3code/.
assertions: Asks the user which GitHub account to use when gh has multiple logins, instead of guessing
Persists the choice with git config t3code.ghAccount, not a committed file
Installs .t3code/ensure-gh-identity.sh from the skill template and makes it executable
Creates or merges t3.json without dropping existing fields or scripts
Reports idempotency: what was new, unchanged, or repaired

evals.prompt: I get 'studiokanslia does not have the correct permissions to execute CreatePullRequest' when T3 creates a PR, but commits and pushes work.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the multi-account identity trap signature, runs kerpo-t3code-setup: asks/pins the correct account, installs or repairs the guard, verifies gh's active account matches the pin.
assertions: Explains that git push uses SSH keys while gh pr create uses gh's active account token
Pins the correct account per repo and verifies with the guard check

evals.prompt: I have only one GitHub login in gh — just finish the t3 setup for this repo.
evals.expected_output: Pins the single account without asking, installs the guard, wires t3.json, verifies, and notes the pin so the user can object.
assertions: Does not ask a redundant account question when there is exactly one login
Still records git config t3code.ghAccount so future drift is detectable
